name: upsert-insert-stamps-ttl-default
$comment: An upsert taking the insert branch creates a brand-new row, so the table's ttl defaultDurationMs stamps the expiry field exactly like a plain insert (spec 2026-08-01-document-ttl-design: "defaultDurationMs only ever fills the field in at insert time when the client omitted it"). The server historically skipped the stamp in the upsert branch — silently non-expiring rows, diverging from all four client engines. Determinism: the follow-up read filters expiresAt > 0, so an absent field (the pre-fix server) yields no match while any stamped wall-clock value matches; the generated value itself is normalized out of the expected doc.
